title: Ultimate Create Collection
description: The Ultimate Create Collection to play. With 300+ mods to explore and build the greatest industrial empire of all time!
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec721a33b6fb54f874bf877f23ca5c533bd7166d.png)
# A lot of gameplay with over 300+ mods to explore

**Our Coolest Features**
- Create with many add-ons with the likes of Create Aeronautics and many more!
- MineColonies to get your industrial cities alive
- Expanded Vanilla World-Gen (So no extra biomes that feel overwhelming)
- Extra Dimensions, End & Nether Overhaul + Draconic Evolution
- Many building blocks and shapes to build with
- Nuclear Reactors and Thermo Generators
- Including Custom Mods from our selfs
- And so much more to discover!

_It will sync all the mods from our download server when starting up, Give it time to search for updates. (It can take a while so let it run the update checker), Also regularly check if you have a update._

![Images from Steampunk SMP (Official Server)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/640bfcf9005fc04daf7716aa17dd278de21f7298_0.webp)
